text.p: Typhoon Violet threatens the Phillipean Sea...

Typhoon Violet has lost a bit of its punch, but is still packing maximum sustained winds of near 145 mph. Violet is located near 20.4N/126.2E and is moving off to the north-northwest at 6 mph. Very slow weakening is expected to continue over the next 24-48 hours as the strom takes a more northeasterly track. Violet is expected to be just southeast of Okinawa on Wednesday. Japan may be threatened later in the week. Shipping will be affected by this storm.

Typhoon tom is located near 22.2N/146.1E and has maximum sustained winds of 85 mph. Tom is moving off to the northeast at 10mph and is expected to continue moving away from land for tne next few days. Tom will only threaten shipping.
